decisions.reason: Because this aloe vera facial care line fits the core range, was given its own page as a visible commitment, and there is no clear sign of failure in a growing market, management would likely continue it.

Because the hyaluronic acid serum is close to the established offer and no disappointing results are reported, management would tend to keep it, though the lower public commitment than Product A makes withdrawal slightly more plausible.

Because the cleansing milk is a routine extension of the firm's existing skincare business and there is no hard evidence that it failed, management would likely keep it despite only limited visible commitment on the website.
